;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**Saudi-led coalition [[airstrike]]s kill at least seven civilians when they hit houses in the [[Al Jawf Governorate]] of [[Yemen]]. The [[Houthis]] report nine killed, two of them children. The coalition did not immediately comment on the airstrike. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security/air-strikes-kill-civilians-in-yemens-al-jawf-province-residents-say-idUSKCN24G1HJ?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[George Floyd protests in the United Kingdom]]
**A statue of [[Black Lives Matter]] protester [[A Surge of Power (Jen Reid) 2020|Jen Reid]] is briefly erected without permission on the plinth of the toppled [[Statue of Edward Colston|statue]] of [[Edward Colston]] in  the city center of [[Bristol]] before being removed the next day. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/edward-colston-slave-trader-statue-replaced-black-lives-matter-protester/ (CBS News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Fiat Chrysler Automobiles]] and [[Groupe PSA]] announce that when their planned merger is completed, expected in 2021, the merged company will be known as [[Stellantis]]. [https://www.freep.com/story/money/cars/chrysler/2020/07/15/stellantis-fca-fiat-chrysler-peugeot-sa/5444259002/ (''Detroit Free Press'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Iran explosions]]
**At least seven ships are burnt following an unspecified incident in the [[Iran]]ian port city of [[Bushehr]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2020/07/15/Fire-breaks-out-at-southern-Iran-Bushehr-port-three-ships-on-fire-IRNA.html (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-07-15/at-least-three-ships-on-fire-in-iran-s-bushehr-port (Bloomberg)]
*At least 50 people have been killed and more than two million affected by heavy [[monsoon]] flooding in [[Assam]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-53415254 (BBC News)]
*A record-setting rainstorm causes [[flash flood]]ing in [[Palermo]], Italy. The meter of water turns streets into rivers and traps motorists in their cars. Palermo mayor [[Leoluca Orlando]] says this "water bomb" dropped as much rain in two hours as the [[Sicily|Sicilian]] capital gets in a full year. Two people are reported drowned; that has not been confirmed. [https://www.voanews.com/europe/record-rain-causes-flash-floods-sicilian-capital-palermo (VOA)] [https://www.euroweeklynews.com/2020/07/16/2-die-trapped-in-car-in-flooding-in-palermo-italy/ (EuroNews)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] announces the biggest daily rise of 87 new [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] deaths, taking the nationwide death toll at 3,797. The country also announces their biggest daily rise of 1,414 new recoveries, taking the nationwide tally to 39,050. The cumulative cases reach 80,000. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5094668/update-lengkap-corona-15-juli-pecah-3-rekor-spesimen-sembuh-meninggal?tag_from=wp_nhl_4 (detikNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reimposes a two-week [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in India|lockdown]] in parts of the country as the country records 30,000 new daily cases. [https://time.com/5867007/india-reimpose-lockdown-coronavirus-1-million/ (''Time'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]	
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alabama]]	
****[[Governor of Alabama|Governor]] [[Kay Ivey]] issues a mandatory statewide [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|face mask]] order through July 31. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/507466-alabama-governor-issues-statewide-mask-order?amp (''The Hill'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
****[[Florida]] exceeds 300,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/florida-surpasses-300000-coronavirus-cases/ (CBS News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Michigan]] reports 891 new cases, its highest single-day new case total since May 14. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/07/michigan-reports-891-new-coronavirus-cases-on-wednesday-july-15-highest-number-in-2-months.html (MLive.com)]

;Law and crime
*[[Killing of George Floyd]]
**A new [[police body camera]] video emerges of [[George Floyd]] pleading with officers before his death. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53425792 (BBC News)]
**A lawsuit is filed against the [[Minneapolis Police Department|Minneapolis police]] officers involved in Floyd's death. [https://www.chicagotribune.com/nation-world/ct-nw-george-floyd-family-sues-minneapolis-officers-20200715-y6u5cyluanccfb3lgbkp2gx7gi-story.html (''The Chicago Tribune'')]
*[[Crime in Norway]]
**A woman dies and two more people are injured during a series of stabbings in [[Sarpsborg]], [[Norway]]. A Norwegian man, who had a relationship with the two wounded victims, is arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-53415690 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 Twitter bitcoin scam]]
**The [[Twitter]] accounts of notable people and businesses, including [[Elon Musk]], [[Joe Biden]], [[Bill Gates]] and [[Apple Inc.]], are hijacked to promote a [[Bitcoin]] scam. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/07/15/hackers-appear-to-target-twitter-accounts-of-elon-musk-bill-gates-others-in-digital-currency-scam.html (CNBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign]]
***[[President of the United States|President]] Trump replaces [[Brad Parscale]] as campaign manager with [[Bill Stepien]], former [[White House]] political director and a field director for the 2016 presidential campaign. Parscale, who has reportedly been blamed for the poorly attended [[2020 Trump Tulsa rally|rally]] in [[Tulsa, Oklahoma]], last month, will stay on as senior adviser. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-53426285 (BBC News)] [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2020/07/15/Trump-replaces-2020-campaign-manager-Brad-Parscale-with-Bill-Stepien/5521594862183/ (UPI)]
*[[2020 North Macedonian parliamentary election]]
**Voters in [[North Macedonia]] head to the polls to elect the members of the country's [[Assembly of North Macedonia|assembly]]. It is the first election after the country adopted its new name following a [[Macedonia naming dispute|decade-long dispute]]. The election had to be postponed once due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in North Macedonia|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jul/15/race-too-close-to-call-as-north-macedonia-holds-first-poll-since-name-change (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Politics of Peru]]
**[[Prime Minister of Peru]] [[Vicente Zeballos]] resigns in the face of harsh criticism of his management of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru|COVID-19 pandemic]]. He is succeeded by [[Pedro Cateriano]]. [https://www.expreso.com.pe/politica/hasta-pronto-presidente-martin-vizcarra-asi-fue-la-despedida-de-vicente-zeballos/amp/ (''Expreso'')]
